name: Villaggio Mall
slides: 125,000 m² of retail, all on one floor
A 150-metre indoor canal runs through the mall. Gondolas carry shoppers along one wing.
Look up. That sky isn't real.
Above the Venetian-style shopfronts, the ceiling is painted as a blue sky full of clouds.
The indoor theme park Gondolania has Qatar's only Olympic-size ice rink, plus a roller coaster, go-karts and bowling.
The gondolas drop shoppers at Via Domo, a luxury street with Dior, Gucci, Louis Vuitton, Bulgari and Cartier.

caption:
The Doha mall with a 150-metre Venice canal inside 🇶🇦

Villaggio Mall opened in Qatar's Aspire Zone in 2006. Gondolas glide along an indoor canal under a painted sky to Via Domo, home of Gucci and Cartier. There's even an Olympic-size ice rink.

Would you take the gondola or just walk? 👇
